words.defn_en: to gradually establish an idea or feeling in someone's mind:

sentences.en: Good coaches ______ confidence in their players.
sentences.zh: 優秀的教練會為球員灌輸信心。

sentences.en: Her parents worked to ______ a love of reading in her early on.
sentences.zh: 她的父母從小就努力為她灌輸對閱讀的熱愛。

words.defn_en: an act of rising in active revolt:

sentences.en: The government struggled to contain the growing ______ .
sentences.zh: 政府努力遏制這場日益擴大的叛亂。

sentences.en: Historians documented the causes of the regional ______ .
sentences.zh: 歷史學家記錄了這場地區性起義的成因。

words.defn_en: an active revolt against an established authority:

sentences.en: The military was deployed to suppress the ______ .
sentences.zh: 軍隊被部署來鎮壓這場叛亂。

sentences.en: Years of ______ left the country's infrastructure in ruins.
sentences.zh: 多年的叛亂讓這個國家的基礎建設破敗不堪。

words.defn_en: one who rebels:

sentences.en: Government forces clashed with ______s in the mountainous region.
sentences.zh: 政府軍與這些叛亂分子在這片山區發生衝突。

sentences.en: The former ______ eventually became a respected member of parliament.
sentences.zh: 這位曾經的叛軍最終成為國會中受人尊敬的一員。

words.defn_en: a violent uprising against authority:

sentences.en: The failed ______ resulted in dozens of arrests.
sentences.zh: 這場失敗的起義導致了數十人被捕。

sentences.en: Historians still debate the causes of the ______ .
sentences.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在爭論這場起義的成因。

words.defn_en: done on purpose:

sentences.en: By reading the evidence, I could tell the man's actions were ______.
sentences.zh: 透過檢視證據,我看得出這名男子的行為是蓄意的。

sentences.en: Her omission of that detail seemed entirely ______.
sentences.zh: 她刻意省略那個細節,看起來完全是有意為之。

words.defn_en: to overawe:

sentences.en: The bully tried to ______ the younger students into giving him their lunch money.
sentences.zh: 這個惡霸試圖恐嚇年紀較小的學生交出午餐錢。

sentences.en: She refused to let his angry tone ______ her during the negotiation.
sentences.zh: 在談判過程中,她拒絕讓他憤怒的語氣恐嚇到自己。

words.defn_en: very detailed or complex; complicated in design or structure:

sentences.en: The ______ pattern on the fabric was carefully designed.
sentences.zh: 這塊布料上精細複雜的花紋是精心設計的。

sentences.en: The artist created an ______ design on the fabric.
sentences.zh: 這位藝術家在布料上創作出一幅精細複雜的圖案。

words.defn_en: arousing curiosity or interest:
words.defn_zh: 引人入勝的/耐人尋味的

sentences.en: The mystery novel was ______ because I couldn't figure out who the murderer was.
sentences.zh: 這本推理小說十分引人入勝,因為我猜不出誰是兇手。

sentences.en: She found the professor's theory ______ but hard to believe.
sentences.zh: 她覺得這位教授的理論很耐人尋味,但難以置信。

words.defn_en: a swelling; the process of swelling up:
words.root_note: in- (into) + tumescere (to begin to swell), from Latin

sentences.en: The doctor examined the ______ around the injury.
sentences.zh: 醫生檢查了這處傷口周圍的腫脹。

sentences.en: Chemists observed a rapid ______ when the two substances mixed.
sentences.zh: 化學家觀察到這兩種物質混合時出現了迅速的膨脹。

words.defn_en: to flood:be full of

sentences.en: The customer service line was ______ with complaints after the website crashed.
sentences.zh: 網站當機後,客服專線被大量投訴電話淹沒。

sentences.en: Heavy rains ______ the entire village within hours.
sentences.zh: 豪雨在數小時內淹沒了整座村莊。

words.defn_en: an overwhelming abundance; a flood:
words.root_note: in- (into) + undare (to flow, surge), from Latin

sentences.en: The office received an ______ of complaints after the announcement.
sentences.zh: 宣布消息後,這間辦公室收到了大量湧入的抱怨。

sentences.en: Coastal towns prepared for the seasonal ______ of the river.
sentences.zh: 沿海城鎮為這條河流季節性的氾濫做好了準備。

words.defn_en: to cause someone to become accustomed to a situation:

sentences.en: Years of working night shifts had ______d him to sleeping during the day.
sentences.zh: 多年的夜班工作已讓他習慣了白天睡覺。

sentences.en: Soldiers become ______d to hardship after months on the front lines.
sentences.zh: 士兵在前線待了數月後,對艱苦生活變得習以為常。

words.defn_en: accustomed to something unpleasant through repeated exposure:
words.root_note: in- (into) + euvre (use, work), from Old French

sentences.en: After years on the job, she became ______ to gruesome scenes.
sentences.zh: 在這份工作多年後,她對可怕的場景已經習以為常。

sentences.en: Soldiers can grow ______ to the sounds of battle over time.
sentences.zh: 士兵久而久之會對戰場上的聲音變得麻木。

words.defn_en: to enter forcibly as an enemy; to intrude:

sentences.en: Enemy troops began to ______ the northern border.
sentences.zh: 敵軍開始入侵北方邊境。

sentences.en: Reporters were accused of trying to ______ the celebrity's privacy.
sentences.zh: 記者被指控試圖侵犯這位名人的隱私。

words.defn_en: tending to intrude on or interfere with something, often in an unwelcome or harmful way:

sentences.en: The ______ species spread quickly and threatened the local ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 這種入侵物種迅速擴散,威脅到當地的生態系統。

sentences.en: Doctors recommended a less ______ procedure to treat the condition.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議採用侵入性較低的療程來治療這個病況。

words.defn_en: insulting, abusive speech:

sentences.en: The senator's speech was full of ______ against his opponent.
sentences.zh: 這位參議員的演說充滿了針對對手的猛烈抨擊。

sentences.en: He hurled a stream of ______ at the referee after the call.
sentences.zh: 在那次判決之後,他對裁判連珠炮似地破口大罵。

words.defn_en: to attack verbally:=castigate =reprimand

sentences.en: The columnist continued to ______ against corruption in local government.
sentences.zh: 這位專欄作家持續猛烈抨擊地方政府的貪腐問題。

sentences.en: He would often ______ against what he saw as unfair taxation.
sentences.zh: 他常常痛罵他認為不公平的稅制。

words.defn_en: to create something new:

sentences.en: Thomas Edison ______ the incandescent light bulb.
sentences.zh: 湯瑪斯·愛迪生發明了白熾燈泡。

sentences.en: Children often ______ imaginary games to play with their siblings.
sentences.zh: 孩子們常常發明想像遊戲和兄弟姊妹一起玩。

words.defn_en: having the ability to create new things or ideas; creative and original:
words.defn_zh: 有創造力的/善於創新的

sentences.en: The ______ designer introduced new ideas that transformed the industry.
sentences.zh: 這位富有創意的設計師提出新穎的構想,徹底改變了整個產業。

sentences.en: Her ______ solutions to everyday problems earned her a promotion.
sentences.zh: 她針對日常問題提出的創新解決方案,讓她獲得了升遷。

words.defn_en: systematic inquiries to uncover facts:

sentences.en: The police conducted a thorough ______ of the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 警方對犯罪現場進行了徹底的調查。

sentences.en: The company launched an internal ______ into the allegations.
sentences.zh: 這家公司針對這些指控展開了內部調查。

words.defn_en: the action of putting money into something for future benefit:

sentences.en: Real estate remains a popular long-term ______ .
sentences.zh: 房地產仍是一種受歡迎的長期投資。

sentences.en: The company made a significant ______ in renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 這家公司對再生能源進行了大量投資。

words.defn_en: habitual, firmly established:

sentences.en: He is an ______ gambler who can't resist a bet.
sentences.zh: 他是個積習難改的賭徒,無法抗拒下注的誘惑。

sentences.en: Her grandmother was an ______ storyteller, always ready with a tale.
sentences.zh: 她的祖母是個說故事成癮的人,總是隨時準備好講一個故事。

words.defn_en: to give strength or energy to:

sentences.en: A cold shower can ______ you first thing in the morning.
sentences.zh: 一場冷水澡能在早晨第一時間讓你精神振奮。

sentences.en: The team's win seemed to ______ the entire town.
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍的勝利似乎讓整座小鎮充滿了活力。

words.defn_en: making one feel stronger and more energetic:

sentences.en: The mountain air felt wonderfully ______ .
sentences.zh: 山間的空氣讓人感到十分振奮清爽。

sentences.en: She found the debate ______ rather than exhausting.
sentences.zh: 她覺得這場辯論令人振奮,而非疲憊。

words.defn_en: to include as a necessary part or consequence:

sentences.en: The project will ______ collaboration between three different departments.
sentences.zh: 這項計畫將牽涉到三個不同部門之間的合作。

sentences.en: She didn't want to ______ her family in the legal dispute.
sentences.zh: 她不想讓她的家人牽涉進這場法律糾紛。

words.defn_en: a second or new birth:

sentences.en: Many Hindus and Buddhists believe in ______ as part of the soul's journey.
sentences.zh: 許多印度教徒和佛教徒相信輪迴轉世是靈魂旅程的一部分。

sentences.en: She jokingly claimed to be the ______ of a famous painter from centuries ago.
sentences.zh: 她開玩笑地聲稱自己是幾世紀前一位知名畫家轉世投胎。
